278947254.description: This listing includes two vintage wooden tobacco pipes featuring dark brown and natural tan finishes. One pipe has a curved stem with a '43' label, while the other has a straight stem labeled '30'. Both pipes exhibit surface wear, patina, and residue in the bowls, reflecting their age and history. They are collectible estate items sold as untested.

278966829.description: This collection features a variety of minerals, crystals, and gemstones in both rough and polished forms. Included are stones such as amethyst, rose quartz, agate, jasper, and possibly fluorite, along with unique shapes like hearts and a carved skull. The pieces come in multiple colors including pink, green, purple, brown, blue, and clear, with some cut into slabs and others tumbled or in natural form. A small blue velvet drawstring pouch is also part of the lot.

Description
: Discover the natural world with this assorted Rocks & Minerals Collection Lot, perfect for learners, collectors, and hobbyists alike. This lot includes 13 individually-labeled specimens, each sealed in its own plastic bag with identification cards detailing names and brief descriptions. Featured minerals and rocks visible include sodalite, lepidolite, calcite, agate, marble, lava, pumice, pyrite (fools gold), alabaster, selenite, obsidian, and 'gold ore'all offering visual diversity from deep blues to crystal-clear textures, and metallic lusters. Also included is a white crystalline specimen and a small blue-green shard, both separate from the labeled bags, along with an educational information card. All items are housed in a translucent bag. These pieces make a hands-on teaching aid or starter set for anyone interested in geology or earth sciences. Signs of prior handling are visible, including wear on packaging and handwritten marking on the outer bag, indicating a used condition. Review photos to see exact specimens and their included cards.
